_comment: Gates that open while characters stand on every one of their plates (Managers.PlateGates).
obstacles: the cells the gate stands on, unwalkable in the client's map data while it is shut.
inside: the cells behind it; whoever is still there when it shuts is put back on «outside»,
unless he meets «stays». Each character on a plate counts only if he meets «criterion».

gates.why: The wabbits' tic-tac-toe room under the Cawotte island [22,-10], «Voyage au centre du Wabbit» (842) of Dofus pour les noobs: «il vous faut être 3 minimum pour ouvrir la grille et ces 3 personnes doivent en être au même point ou plus loin que vous dans ces quêtes. Placez les personnages sur les dalles marquées d'un point violet» -- the guide's three plates, one on each of the three boards; its guardian's riddle says the same, one on each board that has a trick. The gate is the two graphic-854 elements on 269 and 284, the only way onto the ledge (the client's linked zone 32) where the guardian and the door to «Des pwinces pas très charmants» stand. «Si vous ne lui parlez pas avant que la grille se referme, lorsque la grille se refermera votre personnage sera remis à l'extérieur de la grille»: put back on 298, the first cell in front of it. INFERRED: thirty seconds open.

The Giant Kralamoure's lair, [-60,-8] in the Tourbière nauséabonde (dungeon 31). In the game 48 characters stand on the plates of four rooms of Otomai's island ([-52,15], [-49,9], [-56,4], [-55,11]), then one on the plate in front of the lair: «la grille s'ouvre», for about forty minutes (Dofus pour les noobs, dofus-portals). A server of a handful of players never gathers 49, so here the plate in front of the lair opens it alone: a CHOICE, not the game's rule. The plate is cell 376, measured by the player standing on the brown slab. The gate is element 453562, graphic 849, on cell 317: not walkable, and nothing walkable behind it -- it is itself the way in, a passage to the first room in content/interactives/teleports.json, which lets through only while the gate stands open (PlateGates.MayPass). Without this entry it was never declared, so never drawn: the lair looked open and could not be entered. Its opening is announced to the whole server with the client's own «Les portes de l'Antre du Kralamoure Géant se sont ouvertes» (info message type 0, 1479). drawsState false: its element keeps its map drawing, which already looks open; drawn with the open state 1 it stopped being clickable -- the plate opened it and no click came any more --, so the passage itself refuses while it is shut.
